messages:
ella_sales: FYI Acme POC reporting broken JSON payloads from our JSON-mode responses. Their parser fails with EOF midway through a string. Can we triage? :mag:

acme_eng: Example error from our service:
```
Error: unexpected end of JSON input at position 1048
snippet: '{"events":[{"eid":"e1","msg":"started\ninfo"}, {"eid":"e2","msg":"unfinished string with escaped quote \" and more...'
```
We tried bumping client max_tokens but still see cut-off.

pablo_se: Thanks. Are they using endpoint-level json_mode or function_call? Also share the request_id from the response headers.

acme_eng: Using json_mode with schema validation on our side. Model pinned: open-instruct-XXL int8. request_id header: r-1b7f9a6c.

mei_eng: Pulling logs for r-1b7f9a6c from runtime. Quick summary: stream write returned EPIPE after ~1.1k tokens; runtime flush threshold is 1k bytes, which aligns with cut. We also saw json-mode buffer did not flush final closing tokens.

ivan_ops: Minimal logs:
```
[2026-02-16T09:04:12Z] conn 2210: write 1102/1102 -> closed (EPIPE)
[2026-02-16T09:04:12Z] model=open-instruct-XXL token_count=1108 batch_flush_bytes=1024
[2026-02-16T09:04:12Z] json_out: buffered=9876 flush_missed=true
```
So it's LB/socket chunk cut + our chunker boundary mismatch.

pablo_se: Two immediate customer-safe mitigations: 1) Ask the customer to set their client to wait longer for the stream end (e.g., socket timeout 12s) and to run a JSON sanity check before storing; 2) We can flip json_mode to non-streaming for their calls (server-side assemble full JSON before returning). That avoids streaming chunk problems but increases latency.

acme_eng: We can add the timeout and sanity check. They prefer not to change model/quant. Can you do anything in your infra?

mei_eng: We can increase the runtime batch_flush_bytes for their Dedicated pool to 4096 to reduce mid-json flushes. I'll propose config change and run smoke tests. Also will add a temporary guard to the chunker to ensure final `]}` is flushed even if socket closes (best-effort).

marta_sec: Security note: confirm whether any truncated outputs ended up in persistent logs with customer PII. If any secrets were present, rotate them. We'll scrub any transient log files after patch.

ella_sales: Customer asks about retries: if we transparently retry the model request will they see duplicates? They dedupe by event id but worried about double writes.

pablo_se: We should not retry semantically for json_mode responses without at-least-once semantics agreed. Recommend they dedupe on their side and we avoid auto-retries for these requests.

ivan_ops: Action plan: (1) Mei will open infra change ACME-POC-007 to bump batch_flush_bytes and add chunker guard (ETA 3h). (2) Pablo will send customer note with client timeout + jsonlint suggestion and dedupe guidance. (3) Marta will scan logs and scrub if needed.

deploy-bot: change ACME-POC-007 created and queued for pool `acme-poc` - smoke tests scheduled.

acme_eng: Thanks. We'll add jsonlint and increase client socket timeout. Please ping when ACME-POC-007 completes so we can re-run the failing sample.

mei_eng: Will update here after smoke tests. In the meantime, if they hit the issue again, please capture request_id and sample raw bytes so we can correlate.

ella_sales: Appreciate the quick swarm. I'll keep the customer in the loop. :thumbsup:
